body:
Deferred from S459-08 ('DEFER THAT PUT IT IN THE BACKLOG'). draw_grid() drew an unconditional, infinite (+/-4000 unit) cyan grid for every scene, including SCENE_CUSTOM_LEVEL -- now bounded to the real, configured ground-plane footprint (or skipped entirely when disabled), reusing the exact same g_custom_level_ground_plane_enabled/_squares + CUSTOM_LEVEL_GRID_CELL_SIZE values S459-08's own collision logic already uses and live-verified numerically. Every other scene's own infinite grid is unchanged. Compile-check clean. Commit 3c12aa8.

⚓ ☃
title: S459-09: bound the static Matrix-floor grid to a custom level's own footprint
